system.description:
1st Level Clan Feature

You have to work harder to move in combat than your peers. You don’t have inherent special movement abilities like the Namikaze, Jiton or Hoshigaki. You weren’t born special. You had to work for yours. This is expressed in the following mobility options. You select one, selecting an additional option at 11th levels.

Surface Step

Your ability to adhere to a surface with chakra is exceptionally refined. When Wall or Water Walking, you no longer spend additional movement per foot traveled, allowing you to move at your full speed on walls, ceilings and across water. Additionally, you no longer make saving throws and checks to resist being knocked prone, pushed or pulled at disadvantage while Wall or Water Walking.

Deep Diver

Your Chakra control extends to your respiratory system. Double the length of time you can hold your breath both in and out of combat. Additionally, you gain a Swim speed equal to your movement speed.

Quick Shift

Your footwork has been refined to handle most hostile surfaces. Terrain that deals damage to you as you move through it is less effective against you. Reduce the damage you take from such terrain by 5. If you have DR, you can choose to instead apply your DR to the damage of this terrain.

Off Center Assault

While Wall Walking, if you make a melee attack against a creature that is not Wall Walking on the same surface, you overwhelm them with an assault from an angle they aren’t used to fending off. These attacks deal an additional 1d6 damage on a hit.

Silent Cross

While Wall Walking, Water Walking, Swimming or Burrowing, your movement is silent, making no sound. Creatures attempting to perceive you using sound make their checks at disadvantage. You are invisible to creatures using Tremor sense while using one of the listed special movements.

Flow State

When entering any form of special movement, you do not spend the normal 10 feet of movement to activate said special movement, allowing you to move between different special forms of movement with ease compared to other shinobi who are slowed down with each transition.

Chakra Suppressed Steps

While using Wall or Water Walking, you cannot be seen by Chakra Sight passively. A creature can only see you with Chakra Sight if they are performing the Search skill action and beating your Passive Stealth or Stealth DC, whichever is higher.

Living Shadow

Once per turn, on your turn, while in dim light or darkness, you can spend 10 feet of your movement to attempt the Hide skill action. Additionally, when you are Sneaking you can move up to your full speed.
